summary.text: On Ravnica, as the Gatewatch's fight against Nicol Bolas nears its penultimate moment, the guilds' fragile peace is pushed toward breaking point.

Bolas hires Kaya to kill the Obzedat and become Orzhov guildmaster, takes Dovin Baan in so that he rises to lead the Azorius, and helps Domri Rade become Gruul guildmaster, while Niv-Mizzet warns of the threat and has Ral Zarek turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon.
At the guild summit Vraska petrifies the sphinx Isperia, shattering hopes for cooperation, and Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon as Bolas arrives on the plane.
